therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ADAS-Cog11 and ADCS-ADL at 76 weeks

results.effect_size: ADAS-Cog11 LS mean change: LY450139 7.37 vs placebo 6.77; ADCS-ADL LS mean change: LY450139 -10.49 vs placebo -9.77
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma Aβ1-42 decreased by 16.03% in LY450139 arm vs increased 76.37% in placebo arm (p=0.009), indicating target engagement; CSF Aβ1-42 increased in LY450139 arm (+19.20 pg/mL) vs decreased in placebo (-21.39 pg/mL)
biomarker_changes: Plasma Aβ1-42: LY450139 -16.03% vs placebo +76.37% at 52 weeks (p=0.009)
CSF Aβ1-42: LY450139 +19.20 pg/mL vs placebo -21.39 pg/mL (p=0.417)
CSF total tau: LY450139 -11.60 pg/mL vs placebo +117.88 pg/mL (p=0.117)
CSF p-tau: LY450139 +7.94 pg/mL vs placebo +14.75 pg/mL (p=0.318)
AV-45 PET amyloid SUVR: LY450139 -0.36 vs placebo +0.16 (p=0.326)
Right hippocampal volume: LY450139 -158.50 mm³ vs placebo -73.60 mm³ (p=0.101)
Left hippocampal volume: LY450139 -84.41 mm³ vs placebo -111.27 mm³ (p=0.772)
subgroup_findings: Right hippocampal volume change: LY450139 -158.50 mm³ vs placebo -73.60 mm³ (p=0.101)
Left hippocampal volume change: LY450139 -84.41 mm³ vs placebo -111.27 mm³ (p=0.772)
safety_signals: All LY450139 dosing was stopped due to evidence of dose-dependent cognitive/functional worsening
Bradycardia reported in 2/556 LY450139 patients during treatment period
Myocardial infarction reported in 1/556 LY450139 patients during treatment period

dose_info.dose_modifications: All LY450139 dosing stopped due to evidence of dose-dependent cognitive/functional worsening

context.duration: 76 weeks treatment plus 16 weeks post-cessation follow-up
context.investigator_commentary: All LY450139 dosing was stopped due to evidence of dose-dependent cognitive/functional worsening. Participants were followed off-dose for 32 weeks.
